ns2:section.sectionText: Commedia dell?arte Traditions in Opera Since Goldoni This survey course considers the legacy of commedia dell?arte traditions in the period spanning from the late 18th century (Haydn's Il mondo della luna/Mozart?s trilogy with Da Ponte) through to the mid-twentieth century. Special attention will be paid to generically hybrid works, in which comedy and tragedy intersect, and those concerned with parody and surrealism. Later 19th-century repertoire will include Verdi?s Falstaff and Leoncavallo?s Pagliacci before we turn our attention to Ariadne auf Naxos, Prokofiev?s The Love for Three Oranges, Shostakovich's The Nose, and Stravinsky?s The Rake's Progress.
